notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.5 Hotfix
notes.notes: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.5 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes for PC version of the game - 1.0.5 :)[/p][list][*][p]corrected the name of Engineer Kim's second log in SECM (handheld tablet).[/p][/*][*][p]fixed incorrect name of module 04 when the module was unpowered.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed computer logout in module 05 in loop 8.[/p][/*][*][p]improved buttons brightness in game settings in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Personal tablet (SCM) fix: now the item description doesn't stay on screen after entering the inventory in SECM.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23 :) :)[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.4 Hotfix
notes.notes: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.4 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes for PC version of the game - 1.0.4 :)[/p][list][*][p]fixed audio settings during all gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug with bulkhead in soth corridor where when a fire is active in the corridor the mouse cursor would not appear next to the terminal in loop 1.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bugs where after changing interaction keys, the new key settings didn't work in some places.[/p][/*][*][p]gamepads - I added an option in terminals and computers that when you press the east button, it returns to the main menu of the computer/terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes in loop 5.[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes in game translations (EN).[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes and improvement in player movement.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.3 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes - 1.0.3 :)[/p][p]- fixed incorrectly displayed card with clue in loop 5,[/p][p]- fixed menu in loop 5,[/p][p]- gamepads mod: if you log in to the terminal/computer/keypad in game, use the east button on gamepad to return to the start option on the computer or exit the keyboard screen.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

notes.title: Forgotten 23 v1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 v1.0.2 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Listening to you, players, I have prepared a small HotFix for the game - below is a list of things I have improved:[/p][p]- changing "How to play" screen in Loop 01 for lower resolutions.[/p][p]- if you run SECM and the pause menu - SECM will close automatically now and the character no longer moves when opening and closing pause menu or SECM.[/p][p]- add key E to confirm/submit buttons in SECM and computers/terminals (Enter works too!)[/p][p]- changed incorrect text in the computer in module 2, indicating that you need to "press space" (now it's E/ENTER).[/p][p]- disabled unnecessary repairs in module 05 in loops where it is not needed (what could be blocking progress in game).[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]
